fields.label: Default Export Format
fields.options:
ZIP
Git-ready folder
Markdown only
JSON only
fields.description: Format used when a snapshot is generated without an explicit format.

fields.label: Git-ready Output Directory
fields.description: Optional filesystem path where the 'Git-ready folder' export is written (server-side). Leave blank to only attach the ZIP to the snapshot record.

fields.label: Include Raw Source
fields.description: Include full script/SQL/Jinja source in the export. Disable for a lighter, structure-only snapshot.

fields.label: Enable LLM Summaries
fields.description: When off, deterministic heuristic summaries are used (offline, Git-stable). When on, the configured provider generates prose summaries.

fields.label: Include Standard App Artifacts
fields.description: By default only non-vanilla customizations are captured. Enable to also document artifacts owned by standard apps (frappe, erpnext).

fields.label: Include Modules
fields.description: Optional comma-separated allowlist of module names. Blank = all modules.

fields.label: Exclude Modules
fields.description: Optional comma-separated denylist of module names.

fields.label: Enable Scheduled Snapshots
fields.description: When on, the scheduler generates snapshots at the chosen frequency.

fields.label: Retain Snapshots
fields.description: Maximum number of Vigilante Snapshot records to keep. 0 = keep all.
